{{search|staff of the English game|the Japanese Pokémon Stadium|Staff of Pokémon Stadium (Japanese)}}
This is a '''list of staff members''' who worked on the game [[Pokémon Stadium]] (ポケモンスタジアム２ ''Pokémon Stadium 2'' in Japan) for the [[Nintendo 64]], per the [[game credits]]. It was published and developed by [[Nintendo]]. All names are given in Western order.
